collection.description:
4,000 Zorpians, built from almost 200 traits, all of them drawn by hand and with a whole Planet behind them.

Every Zorpian is minted with one company as a trait. NVIDIA, SpaceX, Tesla and nine more, in different quantities, so the company is part of what makes a piece rare.

Switch a Zorpian on and the treasury starts buying that company's stock token for it every day, into a wallet the Zorpian itself owns. Built on Robinhood Chain.

collection.name: HoodMiners
collection.description:
# What is HoodMiners?

HoodMiners is a 5,000-supply free-mint NFT collection on Robinhood Chain built around a simple idea: 
Hood Miners do not just sit in your wallet. They can earn and accumulate assets over time.

*Each Hood Miner is both a collectible and its own smart wallet.* 
Once activated, Miners can earn a share of rewards generated across the HoodMiners ecosystem.

Rewards are designed to include assets such as Bitcoin, with tokenized stocks, gold, and other digital assets potentially introduced in future reward epochs.

What makes the concept different is that these assets accumulate inside the Miner itself. If the NFT is sold, the Miner, its wallet, and the assets accumulated inside it move together to the new owner.
